name: Bully Baby Rescue
neighborhoods: Port Chester (Westchester); serves NY metro incl. NYC
region_note: NYC-ADJACENT (Westchester / lower Hudson / Putnam) - not NYC-based but actively serve NYC adopters & pull from NYC ACC
notes: Based in St Croix, US Virgin Islands, not in New York. Its team there rescues dogs and transports adoptable ones to the US with its New York partner, Pet Rescue (ny-petrescue.org). It also runs spay/neuter clinics on Native American reservations with Underdog Rescue. It does not say it runs clinics in New York City.
